description: This file defines a Kotlin interface for a data repository related to user news resources, specifying methods to observe various streams of news data.

classes.name: UserNewsResourceRepository
classes.description: An interface defining methods to observe user news resources, including all news, followed topics news, and bookmarked news.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a stream of all available user news resources, with optional filtering by topic and news IDs.

methods.name: observeAllForFollowedTopics
methods.description: Returns a stream of news resources related to topics followed by the user.

methods.name: observeAllBookmarked
methods.description: Returns a stream of news resources bookmarked by the user.
